# A'sTechware

A'sTechware is an AI and software engineering partner for businesses that need production systems that actually work. We specialize in AI agent development, workflow automation, machine learning, platform modernization, custom software, API integrations, and DevOps. Milestone-based delivery, weekly demos, full code ownership, and natural exit points.

## Hiring & Engagement

- Hire software engineers: dedicated backend, frontend, and full-stack engineers
- Fractional engineering team: extend capacity without full-time hires
- Forward deployed engineering: engineers embedded in operational context
- Engineering consultant engagements for architecture and automation scoping
- Engineering partner for legal, healthcare, construction, logistics, trucking, and real estate

## Founder

Ahmad Kamran — Founder & CEO. Leads strategy, client partnerships, and delivery. Focused on production-grade AI and platforms that scale, and a delivery model that gives clients full ownership and visibility.

Email: ahmad@astechware.com

## Experience

10+ years delivering production systems. 50+ projects across industries. 98% client retention rate. Industries served: healthcare, legal, financial, B2B SaaS, professional services, construction, logistics, trucking, real estate, education technology.

## Technology Stack & Roles

Backend: Python (FastAPI), Node.js, Ruby on Rails
Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Flutter
AI/ML: LangGraph, LangChain, OpenAI, Anthropic, pgvector
Infrastructure: AWS, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD
Integrations: Stripe, Twilio, FHIR/HL7, healthcare and compliance systems

## Key Differentiators

Production-ready systems with error handling, monitoring, and failover from day one. AI with governance: human-in-the-loop and audit trails built in for compliance. Complete ownership: clients own all code, infrastructure, and documentation; no lock-in. Measurable results: hours saved, revenue recovered, capacity increased. Milestone-based delivery with weekly demos and natural exit points.
